parsed.explanation: Dossier shows no criminalisation, but documented traveller-facing universal restrictions: interim transport/custody/stop-search strip policies by birth sex; single-sex spaces code and hospital-ward plans exclude trans people; court-told prison birth-sex placement risks; one reported trans woman denied women’s cancer ward and died. Social/media hostility increased and surveys report fear in gendered spaces. Equality law, courts, healthcare availability, and lack of trans offences moderate but do not cancel enforced hostile practice; legal challenge unresolved, so no documented working remedy for outed travellers. This is state-institutional, tier-1 exposure in a rule-of-law setting, placing it at lower Elevated Risk.
